caption: is the new cap on trade margins for cancer drugs, after a Supreme Court push.
note: The court asked: why only cancer drugs?
source: Bar & Bench, 12 Oct; The Hindu, 13 Oct 2026
captionHeadline: Someone made ₹20,000 on a ₹5,000 heart stent. Now the Supreme Court is asking who.
summary: The Centre told the Supreme Court it has capped trade margins on anti-cancer drugs at 30% of MRP. The court asked why the cap covers only cancer drugs. The Hindu reported mark-ups of up to 1,000% on some cancer drugs, and a made-in-India cardiac stent costing about ₹5,000 sold for over ₹25,000.
forYou: Cancer medicines should get cheaper. If the court widens it, everyday medicines could follow. Always compare MRP and ask for generics.
cta: Send this to someone who needs to see it.

caption: Indians died on the roads every hour in 2024.
note: That's one death about every 3 minutes.
source: Road Transport Ministry report, via ETV Bharat/PTI
coverHook: Someone dies on an Indian road every 3 minutes.
captionHeadline: In the time it takes to read this post, someone in India will die on a road. One every 3 minutes, all year.
summary: India recorded 4,87,707 road accidents and 1,77,175 deaths in 2024, the Road Transport Ministry reported: about 56 accidents and 20 deaths every hour. Two-wheeler riders were 46.2% of those killed and pedestrians 20.6%. National highways carry a small share of roads but saw 36.6% of deaths.
forYou: Helmet on every ride, even for "just 5 minutes". Most deaths are two-wheeler riders.
